**q25.** Engine: CEL (Common Expression Language) via google/cel-go, located at `internal/filter/`. The filter string is compiled by `engine.Compile()` (`internal/filter/engine.go:48`) which parses the CEL expression into an AST, then `buildCondition()` (`internal/filter/parser.go:18`) converts it to a dialect-agnostic IR. A `renderer` (`internal/filter/render.go`) then translates the IR to dialect-specific SQL (SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL) with parameterized placeholders, handling differences like `JSON_EXTRACT` vs `->>`/`@>`, `?` vs `$N` placeholders, and `ILIKE` vs `memos_unicode_lower`.

**q26.** `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo` (the memo row itself), `memo_share` (via FK ON DELETE CASCADE), plus recursively the same set for any comment memos linked via comment-type relations

**q27.** Go `embed.FS` (`//go:embed dist/*`); wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go` (line 20-21, served via Echo static middleware)

**q28.**
S3 Presign Runner — 12-hour `time.Ticker` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`, started at `server/server.go:162-169`)
Unused infrastructure: `internal/scheduler/` package (a complete cron-style scheduler) is never imported outside its own package. The `server/runner/memopayload/` runner exists but is called inline during memo create/update, not started as a background worker.

**q29.** Interceptor: `web/src/connect.ts` (ConnectRPC `authInterceptor` at line 156); token kinds: access token (JWT/HS256, stored in localStorage) and refresh token (HTTP-only cookie `memos_refresh`); backend validation: `server/auth/` package (`authenticator.go` — validates access tokens via `ParseAccessTokenV2` and personal access tokens via SHA-256 hash lookup)
